# Python command reference

[Documentation home](../README.md) | [Tutorial](../try-it.md) | [Results](results.md)

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py; do not edit the inventory. -->

This inventory comes from the installed Python CLI parsers. Run a command with --help for
its options and defaults. Presence here means implemented, not production-qualified.
For setup, artifacts and workflows use the [development runbook](../development-runbook.md).
For edgectl and the Rust host, use the [execution-service reference](execution-service.md).

## edge-delegate

| Command | Parser description |
| --- | --- |
| `edge-delegate control-demo` | preview or explicitly execute exact commands on two software lights |
| `edge-delegate demo` | run the deterministic local vertical slice |
| `edge-delegate pack-check` | verify candidate pack integrity, not release approval |
| `edge-delegate validate` | validate Plan IR without executing it |

## edge-delegate-lab

| Command | Parser description |
| --- | --- |
| `edge-delegate-lab artifact-export` | export verified candidate files, not a qualified release |
| `edge-delegate-lab artifact-verify` | verify a portable adapter manifest and every recorded file |
| `edge-delegate-lab audit-validation` | triage validation failures and compare batch/single planning |
| `edge-delegate-lab benchmark` | measure persistent gateway latency, including failures |
| `edge-delegate-lab compute-inspect` | inspect host compute without a model |
| `edge-delegate-lab compute-plan` | resolve a conservative compute plan |
| `edge-delegate-lab evaluate` | evaluate gold or an installed model plugin |
| `edge-delegate-lab generate-data` | build canonical and model exports |
| `edge-delegate-lab init-example` | create a local-display simulator profile |
| `edge-delegate-lab interactive` | keep a model loaded for non-executing interactive queries |
| `edge-delegate-lab model-doctor` | run model-plugin integration diagnostics |
| `edge-delegate-lab models` | list installed model plugins |
| `edge-delegate-lab plan` | generate and validate one query without executing capabilities |
| `edge-delegate-lab profile-check` | check saved device context without loading a model |
| `edge-delegate-lab qualify` | check evidence; never silently promote a model |
| `edge-delegate-lab reconcile` | check recorded device receipts without planning or executing actions |
| `edge-delegate-lab review-data` | check a v2 draft review workspace; never train, freeze, or approve |
| `edge-delegate-lab run` | explicit persistent execution using an installed adapter |
| `edge-delegate-lab simulate` | run a model query through the real runtime against a simulated display |
| `edge-delegate-lab train` | preflight or train an installed model plugin |

## Software device process

`edge-delegate-device --help` describes the standalone Unix-socket temperature emulator.
It stays running while awaiting requests; that is normal server behavior, not model inference.
Use the managed lab run workflow for first use instead of manually coordinating terminals.

## Not implemented as Python core commands

The Python core has no serve/request/status/reconcile/cancel service commands.
The lab reconcile command is receipt recovery, not a supervised public service.
The control SDK has status/reconcile methods but no whole-request cancellation API.
